summary.en: Added a review of the source-code repository archive. It adds detail to four of the nine company findings (stored finance rows and configuration), explains how earlier exports were built and why their rows repeat, and notes saved profile data. It adds no new affected companies, and nothing reviewed shows a customer database was taken.
summary.zh-Hant: 新增對原始碼儲存庫壓縮檔的檢視。它為九家公司個案中的四家補充了細節（儲存的財務資料列及設定），說明較早匯出資料是如何產生的、為何資料列會重複，並註明已儲存的個人檔案資料。它沒有增加任何新的受影響公司，所檢視的內容亦沒有顯示客戶資料庫曾被取走。

summary.en: Rewrote the whole site for general readers: a plain-language overview with a “what you can do” section, a company search with plain labels, one card per closely examined company, a clear account of what was and wasn’t checked, and a shorter technical section. Evidence downloads are unchanged.
summary.zh-Hant: 為一般讀者重寫整個網站：淺白的總覽及「你可以怎麼做」、用語簡單的公司搜尋、每家仔細檢視公司一張卡片、清楚交代檢查範圍，以及精簡的技術附註。證據下載檔案維持不變。

summary.en: Added complete, expandable report contents and return links so readers can find every company observation, record type and review limit. Evidence and findings are unchanged from the preceding release.
summary.zh-Hant: 新增可展開的完整章節目錄及返回連結，方便讀者找到各項公司觀察、資料類型及檢視限制。證據與發現沿用上一版本，沒有改動。

summary.en: Integrated validated BigQuery reviews of commercial and support associations, stored-field presence, document and billing-model structure, numeric precision, and additional company-name context. Identity, historical ownership and incident-impact limits remain explicit.
summary.zh-Hant: 整合已通過驗證的 BigQuery 檢視結果，包括商業及支援紀錄關聯、儲存欄位存在情況、文件與計費模型結構、數值精度，以及新增公司名稱背景。明確保留身分、歷史擁有關係及事件影響的解讀限制。

summary.en: Added a plain-language reading guide, clearer count explanations and a glossary for readers without a technical background. Evidence and company findings are unchanged.
summary.zh-Hant: 新增白話閱讀指南、數字解說及用語解釋，方便沒有技術背景的讀者理解。證據與公司相關發現維持不變。

summary.en: Added precise release timestamps and integrated validated BigQuery coverage and two reviewed corporate labels, preserving the limits on identity and incident attribution.
summary.zh-Hant: 新增精確版本時間，並整合已通過驗證的 BigQuery 涵蓋範圍及兩個經檢視的公司名稱，同時保留身分核實與事件歸屬的限制。
